title: cyclobalanus cyrtopoda
intro: Cyclobalanus cyrtopoda, commonly known as Taiwan cinnamon or Cyrtopoda, is a species of plant in the family Lauraceae. It is a type of cinnamon tree native to Taiwan, and its bark is used for medicinal purposes. The health benefits of Cyclobalanus cyrtopoda include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve blood circulation, and act as an antioxidant. The bioactive constituents of this plant include cinnamaldehyde, which exhibits therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties.
